Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware that targets browser password stores by decrypting stored credentials using Windows CryptProtectData and CryptUnprotectData functions
Steals credentials from Chromium-based browsers' 'Login Data' SQLite database
Uses stolen credentials for further attacks or sells them on dark web marketplaces
Distributed via website contact form spamming campaigns using Excel XLL files to download and install malware
Impacted Systems: Windows user accounts where malware runs
Attack Vector: Malware infection via spammed Excel XLL files
Exploitation of auto-login feature and stored browser credentials
Credential theft from local user profile
Use of stolen credentials for network intrusion
